contract.form: A complete answer must identify the exact subset \(\mathscr S\subseteq\mathbb Z_{\ge1}\), by an explicit description or an equivalent necessary-and-sufficient condition on \(m\). It must establish that each included \(m\) admits singular configurations of arbitrarily large total size, and that for each excluded \(m\) the sizes of all singular configurations of the stated form are bounded.
contract.not_enough: Examples of singular configurations, even for infinitely many sizes when m varies, do not suffice. Nor do bounds or partial inclusions for \(\mathscr S\), a classification covering only some \(m\), an assertion that the set is unknown or undetermined, or a classification conditional on a conjecture.
